name: What kind of HVAC and electrical considerations are involved in a garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What kind of HVAC and electrical considerations are involved in a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion typically requires extending or installing new HVAC and electrical systems to ensure the space is comfortable and functional as a living area. Garages are often uninsulated and lack proper climate control or sufficient electrical outlets for residential use. AKN Design Group addresses these critical aspects as part of our comprehensive design-build process, ensuring the new space meets current energy codes and provides adequate power for its intended purpose. This detailed planning prevents future discomfort or electrical issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversions require new HVAC and electrical systems for comfort and functionality, which AKN Design Group integrates into the design-build process.
